time_basis: UTC was captured immediately before this review artifact was written; no historical work duration is inferred.

review_scope.question: Does the exact frozen five-file V7 source set implement the same requested-camera comparison, units, and inclusive threshold as the sealed S42 authority, without a source-level false PASS?
review_scope.method: Fresh source/protocol comparison, exact identity rehash, both existing built-in suites and the existing independent synthetic suite under two isolated interpreters, plus a focused pure-in-memory boundary derivation for the differing base anchor. No new lifecycle or isolation attack was added.

dual_interpreter_reproduction.interpretation: All six existing source/synthetic commands return zero. They do not cover the first-cache versus final-cache base-anchor divergence, so they cannot override the blocking source-level false-PASS witness.

focused_numeric_consistency_witness.construction: Let A be cache occurrence 0 ID0. Let final-cache ID0 F differ from A by +0.75e-6 in one translation element and one K element. Let the corresponding elements of IDs1-8 and their batch targets differ from A by -0.75e-6, with exact yaw rotations and exact batch-to-cache equality; preserve cache0 IDs1-4 in cache1.
focused_numeric_consistency_witness.c1_v7_observation: Continuity |F-A|, planned/fixed-K |G-A|, and raw ID8-to-A closure are each 0.75e-6, so camera_guard.py accepts every inclusive <=1e-6 predicate and returns PASS_C1_REQUESTED_CAMERA_INPUT_CONDITION_GUARD_ONLY.
focused_numeric_consistency_witness.sealed_s42_observation: S42 anchors pose, K, and closure to F. The same G differs from F by 1.5e-6 (the observed binary64 K delta is approximately 1.500000053e-6), so the authoritative S42 check fails.
focused_numeric_consistency_witness.mathematical_reason: The implemented premises |F-A|<=tau and |G-A|<=tau imply only |G-F|<=2*tau, while sealed S42 requires |G-F|<=tau.

blocking_findings.finding: V7 computes base_pose/base_k and actual ID0 from cache_commits[0], whereas the exact reviewed S42 authority computes them from cache_commits[1], the final cache. V7 separately permits up to 1e-6 cache overlap drift and up to 1e-6 planned/closure drift from its first-cache base. Those two inclusive bands can point in opposite directions, allowing nearly 2e-6 error relative to S42's final-cache ID0 while V7 reports PASS.
blocking_findings.reproduction: A pure in-memory boundary construction with +0.75e-6 final-ID0 drift and -0.75e-6 planned/closure drift passes V7 at 0.75e-6 on every relevant predicate but fails S42 at 1.5e-6. No real C1 payload, tensor, array, image, or formal path was used.
blocking_findings.impact: The pre-guard can issue a numeric requested-camera PASS for an archive that the sealed S42 scorer must classify as an invalid requested-camera condition. This defeats the guard's sole scientific purpose and can promote an invalid C1 comparison toward terminal authority.
blocking_findings.why_existing_tests_miss_it: The positive fixture gives both cache commits the same ID0 pose/K. Its inclusive boundary case perturbs only a batch matrix element and never puts the two ID0 anchors on one side of the tolerance band and the planned sequence on the other.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use cache_commits[1].c2ws[0] and cache_commits[1].Ks[0] as base_pose/base_k and actual ID0, exactly matching S42, while retaining the cache-overlap diagnostic. Add a regression case with opposing sub-tolerance first/final and planned/final deltas, freeze new source hashes, and require two fresh non-author reviews.

nonblocking_observations.observation: Even after the anchor bug is fixed, this guard establishes only archived requested c2w/K input consistency. It does not establish rendered-pixel camera obedience, visual quality, method gain, causality, novelty, or publication level.

Both supervisor selftests pass with return code zero, but their complete stdout hashes can differ from the author's receipt because the JSON includes live file-stat and runtime observations. This is recorded rather than treated as a deterministic-output claim.

evidence_boundary: Source, static analysis, exact existing dual-interpreter synthetic suites, and one pure in-memory camera-math consistency witness only. No real C1 manifest, receipt, event, tensor, array, image, pixel, model, generation, rendered-camera-obedience, quality, method-gain, causal, novelty, or publication-level evidence.
